title: First Moomoo Data Package
purpose: Retrieve a bounded first package of U.S. market and financial-series observations specifically targeted at current W8E evidence gaps, without creating investment recommendations or runtime-position conclusions.
principles: Use broad-market and sector instruments to observe market structure; do not treat any one security as the United States.
Use company financial statements only as subsystem evidence; do not generalize issuer-level observations to the whole dossier.
Keep raw observations separate from derived claims.
Longitudinal evidence requires explicit start/end windows and field lineage.
Provider package cannot by itself promote G2/P3, G14/P2 or G16/P3.
